description: Conway reference-script fee differential (cardano 11.1.2 vs amaru 0925). Spend a script UTxO via a reference script (minFeeRefScriptCostPerByte=15 surcharge applies) at fee = cardano's computed minimum vs minimum-1, single- and two-reference-script. Result: amaru's computed minimum equals cardano's TO THE LOVELACE (559523 / 561197) - both accept at exact, both reject FeeTooSmall at -1, amaru explicitly states the same 'below minimum 559523'. No fee-consensus divergence. LINEAR tier only (refpair scripts ~7 bytes); the tiered/exponential growth past ~25600 ref-script bytes is substrate-limited (needs a large ref-script UTxO baked).

cases.note: spend via 1 reference script at fee = cardano min 559523 -> both accept
fee 559522 (min-1) -> both reject FeeTooSmall; amaru states 'below minimum 559523' = cardano's exactly
spend + a 2nd reference-script input, fee = cardano min 561197 -> both accept
